title: Mixed Event — Hello to a New Day! — Episode8 Connected Little By Little

meta.Event Outline: It's the start of a new school year and everyone has gone up a grade! That fact hasn't quite hit Ichika yet, but when Miku asks to see the opening ceremony, it spurs her to treat it like a special day.

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So much happened today.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm in a new class, got to talk to my seniors, had band practice, ran into Kanade and Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't say that I've been able to set goals for myself and do what I can to accomplish them like you and the others, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But your story did make me want to try harder moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What made Kanade feel that way...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ichika?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry, I was just spacing out.
I was thinking about everything that happened today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, you had quite an eventful day.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<And I had a lot of fun as a result.
I got to learn so much about the new term at your school, and see all your friends.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Also...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I got to see that Kanade person feel encouraged by your words.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Remember what she said?
She felt like trying harder after hearing your story.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You did what the others did for you, Ichika. You became a source of encouragement for Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I feel that all of that may be connected little by little.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Seeing others try their hardest causes people to feel a variety of things. You may want to give them your support, you may want to do better yourself or match their efforts...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <One person giving it their best causes others to want to do the same.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Isn't that wonderful?
Your efforts may be encouraging and motivating them without you knowing it.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm encouraging them...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I sure hope so.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But if that's true, then I want my music to give others the push they need.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My words and attitude helping others is one thing, but I also want to do that with my music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Right.
And I'm sure you'll be able to, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I'm going to practice on my own until dinner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, then... Why don't you come over to SEKAI? I'd like to play with you.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Then, if you don't mind having me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Then, I'll start getting ready over there.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...!
I forgot to say something really important.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hm?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku.
Thank you for joining me today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I'm looking forward to working with you more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to that as well, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I thought I was just going to start being a second-year in my new class today.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But Miku made me realize it was much more than that.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I started to see it as a special day and decided to be conscious of how everything made me feel...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Now I feel like I'm ready to take another big step.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm going to keep doing my best in my second year...!
